user.title: UL Transport
user.description:
**Live map** draws the buses actually heading to your stops - where they are, when they arrive and how many stops away they are. It needs two free [Trafiklab](https://www.trafiklab.se/) API keys, because UL's own departure API publishes only times, not vehicle positions or route geometry.

Set the keys up once and every stop you add can use them. You can skip this and add it later - departure sensors work without it.

menu_options.trafiklab: Set up the live map (Trafiklab API keys)

trafiklab.title: Trafiklab API keys
trafiklab.description:
Create a project at [trafiklab.se](https://www.trafiklab.se/) and add **two** datasets to it, then paste a key for each below.

Both are on the free Regional tier. They belong to your account rather than to any one stop, so you enter them here once and never again.

data_description.gtfs_static_key: Dataset “GTFS Regional”. Line names, stop names and route geometry.
data_description.gtfs_realtime_key: Dataset “GTFS Regional Realtime”. Vehicle positions and arrival predictions.
